candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (Supplement to the Official Journal of the EU)
candidates.why_relevant: All above-threshold Hungarian public contracts (incl. banking, payment, card acquiring, ATM, cash handling and IT-for-banking services bought by ministries, municipalities, state-owned banks and utilities) must be published EU-wide here. Gives structured, multilingual, machine-readable duplicates of national notices, including contract notices, award notices (with winner and value) and modifications.
candidates.source_subtype: official EU procurement gazette / notice database
candidates.access_status: open, free of charge, no registration
candidates.legal_status: official EU publication; reuse permitted under EU open data / OP reuse policy
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the TED Search API (docs.ted.europa.eu) with expert queries filtered on place-of-performance=HUN plus CPV 66xxxxxx / 72xxxxxx; supplement with daily XML bulk packages. Avoid HTML scraping.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from TED/SIMAP pages
queries_used: TED tenders europa eu contract notice Hungary CPV 66110000 banking services
ted.europa.eu expert search query syntax place-of-performance HUN CPV notice search URL

candidates.source_name: TED Search API (TED Developer Docs)
candidates.why_relevant: Documented, authentication-free API for querying published notices with expert query syntax and retrieving notices in XML. This is the operational backbone for a repeatable HU banking/payments tender feed rather than manual browsing.
candidates.access_status: open; API reportedly requires no authentication for search/reuse
candidates.legal_status: official EU documentation; reuse encouraged for data reusers
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled API polling (daily) with stored expert query; persist notice IDs + XML for diffing.
queries_used: TED europa eu API documentation search notices developer docs eForms bulk download

candidates.source_name: TED XML bulk download packages (daily / monthly)
candidates.why_relevant: Full daily/monthly archives of all TED notices in XML permit backfilling a multi-year Hungarian banking/payments tender history and computing incumbency, contract values and renewal cycles — impossible via the web UI.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch package archives (documented patterns of the form /packages/daily/{OJS number} and /packages/monthly/{yyyy-n}), unpack, filter by country=HU and CPV list. Confirm current URL pattern against the developers' corner page before automating.
queries_used: TED europa eu API documentation search notices developer docs eForms bulk download

candidates.source_name: eForms SDK documentation (OP-TED)
candidates.why_relevant: Defines the eForms schema, field IDs and codelists now used for all Hungarian notices sent to TED. Needed to parse notices correctly (lot structure, CPV, estimated value, award winner, framework agreement flags) and to build stable extraction rules.
candidates.legal_status: EU open documentation; SDK on GitHub (OP-TED)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Pin SDK version; consume codelists and field mappings as reference data for the parser.
queries_used: TED europa eu API documentation search notices developer docs eForms bulk download

candidates.source_name: TED CPV browse (browse by sector) — banking/financial CPV families
candidates.why_relevant: Provides the controlled vocabulary anchor for the whole cell: CPV 66100000 banking and investment services, 66110000 banking services, 66172000 financial transaction processing / clearing-house services, 66600000 treasury services, plus adjacent IT CPVs (72200000, 48000000) that carry core-banking / card-system procurements.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as taxonomy reference to freeze a CPV allow-list; then query via the Search API rather than scraping the browse pages.

negative_findings.description: Searched for a standalone Hungarian RRF procurement portal at rrf.gov.hu; no such dedicated portal surfaced. RRF content appears to live under palyazat.gov.hu and sectoral institution sites (e.g. okfo.gov.hu, ikk.hu).
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence of a separate rrf.gov.hu procurement site; treat palyazat.gov.hu as the RRF hub.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids wasted crawler configuration against a non-existent domain and concentrates monitoring on the real hub.

negative_findings.description: Local-language searching for procurement procedures used to select financial intermediaries for EU-funded financial instruments (közvetítő kiválasztás közbeszerzés) returned programme marketing pages only, not procedure documentation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Intermediary-selection procedure documents for GINOP Plusz financial instruments were not located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is the mechanism by which commercial banks gain access to EU-funded lending volume; if it is not published as a classic tender, a different collection route (MFB corporate disclosures, ministry decrees) is required.

negative_findings.description: TED XML bulk-package URL patterns (/packages/daily/{OJS}, /packages/monthly/{yyyy-n}) were reported in secondary summaries of TED documentation rather than confirmed on the live TED page during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Pattern recorded as a hypothesis to be confirmed against the TED developers' corner before automation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Building a backfill pipeline on an unconfirmed URL pattern risks silent collection failure.

negative_findings.description: Direct search for an actual Hungarian TED notice under CPV 66110000 returned only generic TED explainer pages and one German (D-Aalen) banking-services record; no HU notice was retrieved through general web search.
negative_findings.result_summary: General web search is not a viable discovery channel for individual HU banking notices; the TED search interface/API must be queried directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that the collection method for this cell must be API-first, not search-engine-first.

coverage_gaps.description: The TED Search API was documented but not actually exercised with a HUN + banking-CPV expert query in this pass, so the real volume, notice-type mix and CPV distribution of Hungarian banking/payments notices is unmeasured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a baseline expert query (place-of-performance=HUN AND classification-cpv IN 66100000..66190000, 66172000, 66600000) over the last 36 months and record counts per year and per notice type.

coverage_gaps.description: No verified mapping was established between Hungarian national notice identifiers (Közbeszerzési Értesítő / EKR numbers) and TED notice IDs, which is required to deduplicate the EU-level duplicates against the national layer covered by other cells.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract national reference fields from eForms XML and build an ID crosswalk table; validate on a sample of 20 HU banking notices.

coverage_gaps.description: Banking/payments procurement frequently hides under IT and consulting CPVs (72000000 IT services, 48000000 software, 79000000 business services) rather than 66xxxxxx, e.g. core-banking, card personalisation, ATM/POS estate and cash-logistics contracts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the CPV allow-list with IT/logistics codes and add a Hungarian+English keyword layer (bankkártya, POS terminál, ATM, készpénzszállítás, számlavezetés, fizetési rendszer, elszámolás, acquiring, clearing).

coverage_gaps.description: Opentender.eu's Hungarian data freshness is unknown; DIGIWHIST funding ended in 2018 and the dataset may be stale for recent years.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check the max contract date in the HU bulk export before relying on it; if stale, use it only for historical supplier-share analysis.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level financing bodies that fund Hungarian financial-sector projects outside cohesion policy — EIB, EIF, EBRD project registers and their tender pages — were not covered in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout EIB/EIF/EBRD Hungary project and procurement registers in a follow-up slice.

coverage_gaps.description: Hungarian-language searching was performed for programme, RRF and financial-instrument terms, but not for TED-specific Hungarian notice vocabulary as it appears inside eForms HU-language notices (e.g. 'ajánlati felhívás', 'tájékoztató az eljárás eredményéről', 'keretmegállapodás').
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add these Hungarian notice-type phrases as full-text filters in TED expert queries to catch notices with imprecise CPV coding.

brief: The EU-level layer for Hungarian banking/payments procurement is dominated by one authoritative, machine-readable source — TED, now in eForms format — which duplicates all above-threshold Hungarian notices in structured XML and is reachable through a free, documented Search API plus daily/monthly bulk packages; discovery of individual Hungarian notices via general web search proved ineffective, so collection here must be API-first. A second, distinct layer is EU-funded programme procurement: palyazat.gov.hu (Széchenyi Terv Plusz 2021-2027 and Hungary's RRP) with its procurement section and daily-updated supported-project register, mirrored at EU level by Kohesio, the Cohesion Open Data Platform, the Financial Transparency System and the EU Funding & Tenders Portal. A third, less visible but commercially important channel is EU-cofinanced financial instruments distributed through selected commercial-bank intermediaries under MFB's GINOP Plusz credit programmes, whose intermediary-selection procedures were not found published as classic tenders and need a separate route. Main risks to coverage are CPV under-coding (banking contracts hiding under IT/logistics codes), the absence of a verified national-to-TED notice ID crosswalk, and unverified freshness of the third-party Opentender aggregator.
